primaryBeforeKeys: Displaced water mass rho A h equals fixed own mass plus dry cargo. The vertical guide contributes no support. Every numerical result satisfies h < H = 4 dm and positive cargo; the fixed own mass remains in each inverse and scaling.

propertyAudit.coverage: Pressure-prism integration and depth shift; independent floating cut pieces; taut top-string support; dry-load full-volume limit; own-mass raft geometry. A separate exact test checks one repeated payload root, two admissible lower-target roots and no higher-target real root.

records.assetReview: Geometry uses 50 px/dm: a 2×1 dm base and 4 dm height give a 100×200 px front. Surface y340 crosses bottoms y440 and y490 at depths 100 and 150 px, or 2 and 3 dm. Cargo stays above water. Mass bars 60+60 and 60+120 px at 30 px/kg represent 4 and 6 kg. Graph origin (100,1580), with 50 px/kg horizontally and 50 px/dm vertically: open intercept (100,1530) gives M=0,h=1; solid points (200,1480) and (300,1430) give M=2,h=2 and M=4,h=3; open limit (400,1380) gives M=6,h=4, excluded. Full native rendering and all XML read.
records.distractors: 1 dm counts cargo alone. 4 dm is complete immersion, excluded here. The guide supplies no vertical support.
records.manualArithmetic: Total mass is M + m₀ = 4 kg, requiring 4 dm³ displaced water. On a 2 dm² base this gives h = 2 dm, strictly below H = 4 dm.
records.physicalAssumptions: Prismatic rigid closed impermeable raft, fixed own mass m₀ = 2 kg, positive constant base A, and total height H = 4 dm. Homogeneous quiet water has density 1 kg/dm³. Centered positive dry cargo M has no own buoyancy. An ideal frictionless lateral guide prevents tipping and supplies no vertical force. Vertical equilibrium requires 0 < h < H, equivalently M + m₀ < rho AH. Trials may change base and cargo.

reviewSequence: All 80 original U3-02 prompts 084–088 read individually from pinned Git, excluding original options, answers and solutions. Primary balances, every numerical result, inverses, units and admissible domains were recorded before reading candidate keys. Then all candidate prompts, offered alternatives, full text/formula/figure blocks, hints, feedback, metadata and provenance were read. All five SVG files were read completely in XML and full native PNGs. Final caption 086-03 was reread from author commit 31ca831 before freezing that edition; the other 15 records, keys, formulas and asset were unchanged. After the mobile layout finding, only the final figure caption of record 01 was reread from author commit 6d9fecbb. All values, scale declarations, assumptions, assets, formulas and answers were preserved. Its signature alone was replaced; the other 15 reading signatures were verified unchanged.
scope: Independent AI scientific and pedagogical review of exact read drafts. This is not human approval or publication.
